method: Direct view_image of unmodified PNG files, alongside complete-pixel audit; no generated images or retouched screenshots.

observations.name: nested mobile theme switch
observations.finding: The test switches dark to light. Notification remains at the viewport top over the nested modal; diagnostic and Copy error remain legible.

observations.name: expanded pinned and passing stack
observations.finding: All pinned cards and transient notifications remain visible without overlap. Main puts Show less after passing notifications; project historical screenshot placed it before them.

observations.name: phone confirmation failure
observations.finding: Toast pixels and viewport positioning match. The visible difference is the Save button fill, outside the notification (x294..358,y224..256). No claim that the whole page is pixel-identical.

observations.name: phone selected diagnostic
observations.finding: The after image shows the selected diagnostic text highlight where the historical image shows unselected text. Rest of screenshot matches by pixel audit; images remain unmodified.

observations.name: desktop selected diagnostic
observations.finding: Historical image retains blue selected-text highlight; later image clears it. Difference lies at diagnostic text x954..1099,y69..83.

images.finding: Two pinned cards, a short pill and the Undo result are distinct, right-aligned and do not overlap one another. Show less follows the whole stack as main specifies.
The one attention card stays at the phone viewport top across the bottom drawer and nested dialog. Retry merge and Copy error are visible; no duplicate Open session is rendered.
